production_behavior: A routed Official MCP invocation cannot use a retired control source or MCP Attempt after credential/discovery/protocol awaits. The existing native Official service checks the captured synchronous assertion immediately before each provider fetch after body preparation. A request-local typed witness distinguishes zero tools/call entry from an entered result with uncertain effects. Result publication also rechecks this service's own lifetime synchronously after the last awaited output fence, retaining private-output suppression if disposal completed during that fence or before its continuation. The default native composition captures the canonical Coordinator account binding before asynchronous execution and checks that same binding at publication; source-only retirement remains distinct from account departure.
